01-hero-timer.headline: Time each contraction with one calm tap
01-hero-timer.accessibilityDescription: Olive idle timer with a large Start button, birth-journey tools, and manual-entry access.

02-contraction-active.headline: Keep the live timer clear and easy to reach
02-contraction-active.accessibilityDescription: Olive timing an active contraction with elapsed time, start time, and Stop control.

03-history.headline: Review and correct a clear factual history
03-history.accessibilityDescription: Olive contraction history showing timestamps, durations, intervals, and edit controls.

04-add-missed.headline: Missed one? Add it in seconds
04-add-missed.accessibilityDescription: Olive manual entry sheet with start and end time fields for a missed contraction.

05-care-plan-reminder.headline: Follow the reminder saved from your own care plan
05-care-plan-reminder.accessibilityDescription: Olive showing an observational timing reminder configured from the user's care-team plan.
